note: Provider answers to the calls the DMM Cast play routes make. Each entry says where it comes from. No credential, member link or member address appears below.

ad-throttled.source: AllDebrid's throttle, measured 2026-08-02: authenticated endpoints answer an empty HTTP 503 from Cloudflare with an HTML content type and no Retry-After. A 429 was never seen.

ad-unlock-auth-blocked.source: dmm-01 logged this message for nine unlocks from DMM's server between 2026-10-04 00:06 and 00:14 UTC ('Error unlocking AllDebrid link: ...'), with three magnet and user calls refused the same way. The log keeps only the message; the code is AllDebrid's for it, recorded in full when debrid01 and debrid02 first used a key on 2026-08-06, minus the verification token that body carried.

error.message: You are logging from a new location, device or app.. An email has been sent to

ad-unlock-bad-key.source: Recorded 2026-10-04 from zen with a made-up 20-character key and a real /f/ link.

ad-unlock-link-not-supported.source: Recorded 2026-10-04 from zen with a premium test key and a well-formed /f/ token AllDebrid never issued; a truncated real token drew the same. AllDebrid's static demo keys, free and premium alike, answer this for every real /f/ link too.

error.message: This host or link is not supported

ad-unlock-success.source: Recorded 2026-10-04 from zen with a test key on its own /f/ link. The link, id, file name and path are replaced; the rest is as sent.

ad-user-free.source: Recorded 2026-10-04 with AllDebrid's static free demo key (staticDemoApikeyFree), whose answers match a real account's in shape.

ad-user-premium.source: Recorded 2026-10-04 with AllDebrid's static premium demo key (staticDemoApikeyPrem).

rd-permission-denied.request: A Real-Debrid torrent call made by DMM's uploader for a member (endpoint not recorded)
rd-permission-denied.source: Real-Debrid's answer to a member's key, as DMM's uploader stored it (src/test/fixtures/contentRequests/stored-errors.json). Real-Debrid documents HTTP 403 as 'Permission denied (account locked, not premium)' for every endpoint, unrestrict included. The play route's own log keeps only the status: 29 of the 39 unrestrict failures in dmm-01's logs 2026-10-03 22:21-23:38 UTC were 403, from 5 installs, 4 of which had not played anything all week.

rd-unrestrict-hoster-unavailable.source: A stored link that had aged out, measured 2026-08-29: the same answer on every retry over four minutes.

rd-unrestrict-infringing-file.source: Recorded 2026-10-04: a 13-character link stored in Cast on 2024-11-23, unrestricted once with a test account.

rd-unrestrict-ip-not-allowed.source: The body Real-Debrid sent a hosting-provider address when it refused to make a link, with that address replaced by a documentation one. zurg logged the same refusal as 'ip_not_allowed (status code: 403)'.

tb-rate-limited.source: TorBox's lockout answer, measured 2026-08-02: a bare string, and the whole key is refused for the Retry-After window. Requests made during it do not extend it.
